title: Yufei International Chinese Language Education Vertical Large Model Released: Deeply Integrating Professional Teaching Scenarios to Provide Intelligent Services for Global Teachers, Students, and Institutions

content_html:
The integration of artificial intelligence technology with vertical fields is advancing in greater depth. According to a report by CCTV News, the 2026 World Chinese Language Conference officially opened in Beijing on November 13. At the conference, the Yufei Vertical Large Model for International Chinese Language Education was officially released, aiming to provide comprehensive intelligent services for Chinese language learners, frontline teachers, and various educational institutions around the world.

Deep Adaptation Across the Entire Teaching and Learning Chain: Full Coverage of Three Core Groups

As a vertical model that deeply integrates AI technology with the practical needs of International Chinese Language Education, the Yufei large model does not stop at general entertainment-oriented conversation. Instead, it focuses precisely on professional knowledge, teaching principles, and real classroom scenarios, with targeted adaptations for every stage of teaching and learning:

For Chinese language learners worldwide: The model can provide learning assessments with instant feedback and personalized tutoring with on-demand Q&A, helping learners identify and fill gaps through interaction and improve their efficiency.

For frontline teachers: Teachers can interact efficiently with the model through multi-turn conversations to quickly generate a complete set of teaching materials covering pre-class preparation, in-class interaction, and post-class reinforcement, significantly reducing repetitive work and improving daily teaching efficiency.

For Chinese language education institutions worldwide: The platform provides standardized interfaces that can effectively connect resources from various parties and empower specific teaching applications, enabling digital and intelligent innovations to take root in more real-world teaching scenarios.

Promoting Resource Sharing and Digital-Intelligent Transformation

With the official debut of this large model, the industry widely believes that it will not only help promote the global sharing of high-quality teaching resources and intelligent services, but also inject strong foundational momentum into the digital-intelligent and standardized development of International Chinese Language Education. In the future, as it receives feedback and undergoes iteration in more real-world scenarios, this type of vertical large model is expected to play an even more far-reaching role in cross-cultural language communication.
